summary: Solomon makes alliance with Pharaoh marries daughter, people sacrificed in high places because no house built for name, Solomon loved Yahweh walking in statutes of David but sacrificed in high places, goes to Gibeon great high place offers 1000 burnt offerings, at Gibeon Yahweh appears in dream by night says ask what I shall give you, Solomon says you showed great lovingkindness to David my father, you made me king in place, I am but little child don't know how to go out come in, among people you chose great cannot be numbered, give your servant understanding heart to judge your people discern between good and evil for who able to judge this great people? Speech pleased Lord that Solomon asked this, God says because you asked not long life nor riches nor life of enemies but understanding to discern justice, behold I have done according to word, given wise understanding heart, no one like you, also riches honor you did not ask, if you walk in my ways keep statutes as David did I will lengthen days. Solomon awoke behold dream, came to Jerusalem stood before ark sacrifice, made feast. Then two prostitutes come to king, both have child, one dies in night, both claim living child, king says bring sword divide living child in two give half to one half to other, woman whose child is living says O my lord give her living child no wise kill, other says neither mine nor yours divide. Then king says give living child to first woman for she is mother, all Israel heard judgment feared king for saw wisdom of God in him to do justice.
whyItMatters: Solomon's dream and two prostitutes — wisdom requested not riches, tested by case of two mothers — shows wise heart to discern. Foundation for Solomon's reputation and temple building.

keyVerses.text: Now, Yahweh my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know how to go out or come in.
keyVerses.why: Request for listening heart to judge.

questions.question: Why does Solomon sacrifice at high places if Deuteronomy says worship at one place?
questions.answer: Verse 2 notes people sacrificed in high places because no house built for name yet — interim accommodation. Solomon loves Yahweh walking in David statutes but sacrifices in high places (v3). Gibeon is great high place with tabernacle? He offers 1000 burnt offerings there. After temple built, high places become condemned as rival worship. For now, tolerated. Shows even wise Solomon with mixed obedience.

questions.question: What does 'understanding heart to judge, discern between good and evil' mean?
questions.answer: Hebrew lev shomea — hearing heart, listening heart that hears cases. Solomon says I am little child don't know how to go out come in — like immature, needs wisdom to lead great people cannot be numbered. Asks not long life nor riches nor enemies' life but understanding to discern justice. Pleasing to God because request is for others' good to govern well, not self. God gives wise understanding heart like none before nor after, plus riches honor not asked, and conditional long life if walk as David. Wisdom is not knowledge alone but ability to judge rightly.

questions.question: Why two prostitutes and sword divide child? How does this show wisdom?
questions.answer: Two prostitutes living together, both bear child, one dies at night, both claim living child. No witnesses. King says bring sword divide living child in two give half each — shocking. True mother with compassion says give her living child don't kill, other says neither mine nor yours divide. Solomon discerns mother by self-sacrificial love — willing to lose child to save child. Real mother prefers child live with other than die. Wisdom is psychological insight and creating crisis to reveal heart. All Israel feared king for saw wisdom of God to do justice — establishes reputation.

glossary.def: Lev shomea — heart that listens, hears cases with discernment.
Leadership idiom — leading people in daily affairs, military and civic.
Solomon's test — threaten division to reveal true mother who would rather give up than see death.
